canonical_information_definition.observation_days: Last 5 regular business/trading days of each calendar month.
canonical_information_definition.maturities: Nearest and second-nearest standard Nikkei 225 option maturities.
canonical_information_definition.put_strike_rule: Nearest OTM put = maximum strike strictly below same-day Nikkei 225 reference close.
canonical_information_definition.call_strike_rule: Nearest OTM call = minimum strike strictly above same-day Nikkei 225 reference close.
canonical_information_definition.spot_source: Same official OSE/Osaka Exchange daily report: reference Nikkei 225 OHLC/close on the futures page.
canonical_information_definition.daily_pcr_formula: 100 * (put volume at selected strike for near maturity + put volume at selected strike for second-near maturity) / (call volume at selected strike for near maturity + call volume at selected strike for second-near maturity).
canonical_information_definition.monthly_pcr_formula: Arithmetic mean of the five daily PCR observations.
canonical_information_definition.holiday_session_rule: For modern holiday trading sessions, preserve Tsuji's regular business-day convention; Japanese national-holiday sessions are not counted as separate month-end business days.
